newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Belize sees 1997 economic growth at 3.0-3.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Belize sees 1997 economic growth at 3.0-3.5 pct.

text.p: Central Bank of Belize Governor Keith Arnold said the central American country expected economic growth between three and 3.5 percent in 1997 after about 2.5 percent last year.

"This is primarily due to the agriculture sector -- sugar, citrus and bananas, too -- as well as construction and tourism," said Arnold, who was attending the annual meeting of the Bank for International Settlements.
But Arnold said inflationary pressure was expected to remain low, in line with inflation patterns in the United States, due to close bilateral trade ties. -- Zurich +41 1 631 7340
